title: A Quarter Point On Your Mortgage Costs $20,600

beats.say: A quarter point on your mortgage costs you about twenty thousand dollars over thirty years.
beats.visual: an isometric blueprint of a small house balanced on a stack of round coin discs, drafting lines

beats.say: Take a three hundred fifty thousand dollar loan, fixed for thirty years.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a very long bridge span crossing a river, drawn end to end, no lettering

beats.say: At six and a half percent, the monthly payment is about twenty two hundred twelve dollars.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a gear train with one large gear turning a small gear, hand-drafted

beats.say: Over the full loan, you would pay about four hundred forty six thousand dollars in interest.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a vast staircase descending into a deep stepped pit, strong perspective lines

beats.say: Now lower the rate to six and a quarter percent.
beats.visual: a blueprint close-up of a precision dial with a tiny gap between two tick marks, no numbers

beats.say: The payment falls to about twenty one fifty five, a gap of fifty seven dollars a month.
beats.visual: a blueprint of two nearly identical pipes, one slightly narrower, with one tiny drip, exploded view

beats.say: Over thirty years, that gap adds up to about twenty thousand six hundred dollars.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a long hall of identical doors receding to a vanishing point, one-point perspective

beats.say: Here is the part nobody tells you. A small rate gap gets multiplied by three hundred sixty payments.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a lever and fulcrum where a tiny weight lifts a huge block

beats.say: The honest catch: a lower rate can come with fees or points paid up front, which can eat the savings.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a steel hatch with a small hidden latch marked only by arrows

beats.say: Rates, fees, and how long you stay in the home all change the answer.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a bridge truss with a single hairline crack drawn in one thin line

beats.say: So compare the total cost of each offer, not just the headline rate.
beats.visual: a blueprint site plan of a house with a looping arrow leaving and returning

beats.say: This is an illustration, not advice. A quarter point looks tiny, but time makes it large.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a compass and ruler crossing on drafting paper

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: a blueprint of a road arch rising toward a drawn sun, drafting style

caption: $350,000, 30 years: at 6.5% you pay about $446,000 in interest. At 6.25% about $20,600 less. A quarter point adds up. An illustration, not a promise. Educational content, not financial advice.
description: On a $350,000 30-year fixed loan, 6.5% means about $2,212 a month and about $446,000 in interest. At 6.25% the payment is about $57 a month lower, roughly $20,600 less over 30 years. An illustration; fees and points can change the answer. Educational only, not financial advice.
first_comment: What rate would make you refinance? Educational only, not financial advice.

facts.claim: $350,000 at 6.5%, 30 years fixed: payment $2,212.24, total interest $446,406
facts.basis: Standard amortization formula, computed 2026-11-04; principal and interest only

facts.claim: Same loan at 6.25%: payment $2,155.01, total interest $425,804; difference $57.23 a month and $20,602 over 30 years
Assumptions: fixed rate, no taxes, insurance, fees or points; real offers vary
